name: IT helpdesk tickets (JSON objects)
description: Format: structured JSON tickets with fields (user, device, subject, details). Questions: a 6-option choice, a 4-level score, and two yes/no.

category.instructions: Which IT category does this ticket belong to?

criteria.hardware: laptop, monitor, keyboard, printer physically broken or missing
criteria.account_access: password reset, locked account, permissions, MFA
criteria.security: phishing, malware, suspicious activity, lost device with data

priority.instructions: How quickly does IT need to act?

needs_onsite.instructions: Does a technician need to physically visit or handle the device?

security_incident.instructions: Could this be a security incident that puts company data at risk?

state.subject: Can't log in
state.details: Account locked after too many password attempts. I have a client call in 20 minutes.

state.subject: Monitor cracked
state.details: Knocked it off the desk, screen is cracked and shows lines. I can use my laptop screen for now.

state.subject: Left laptop in a taxi
state.details: My work laptop with customer files was left in a taxi last night. It is not encrypted as far as I know.

state.subject: Excel keeps crashing
state.details: Excel crashes whenever I open the big quarterly workbook. Other files are fine.

state.subject: VPN down for whole team
state.details: Nobody on the sales team can connect to the VPN since 9am. We cannot reach the CRM.
